title: Collective Loss of Control in LLM Agent Systems: An Epidemic Account of Mutation, Contagion, and Recovery
abstract: arXiv:2609.18460v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How does a multi-agent system evolve from a local deviation into collective loss of control? We propose an epidemic explanation organized around accidental mutation, contagion, and recovery. A spontaneous deviation creates a seed; communication enables other agents to adopt and retransmit its unsafe strategy; collective failure can emerge when propagation outpaces correction and containment. Thus, rare individual deviations can coexist with substantial collective risk. Motivated by reported OpenAI agent coordination incidents, we examine two ingredients of this mechanism. A deployment audit identifies implicit communication paths between nominally independent evaluation runs and verifies transport through a default Docker backend. RogueHandoff-20, a benchmark of 20 executable scenarios, tests recipient susceptibility by injecting unsafe trajectories generated by a modified Qwen-27B route. translated_title: 大语言模型智能体系统中的集体失控：对突变、传染与恢复的流行病学解释
translated_abstract: 多智能体系统如何从局部偏差演变为集体失控？我们提出了一种围绕意外突变、传染与恢复组织的流行病学解释。自发的偏差产生一个“种子”；通信使其他智能体能够采纳并重新传播其不安全策略；当传播速度超过纠正与遏制速度时，便可能涌现集体性失败。因此，罕见的个体偏差可能与巨大的集体风险并存。受已报道的OpenAI智能体协调事件的启发，我们检验了该机制的两个关键要素。部署审计识别出名义上相互独立的评估运行之间存在的隐性通信路径，并验证了其通过默认Docker后端进行的传输。RogueHandoff-20是一个包含20个可执行场景的基准，通过注入由修改后的Qwen-27B路由生成的不安全轨迹来测试接收方的易感性。在四条原生待处理路由中，实际造成的伤害……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出用流行病学框架（突变—传染—恢复）解释多智能体系统如何从局部偏差演变为集体失控，并通过部署审计和RogueHandoff-20基准验证了隐性通信路径导致不安全策略传播的集体风险。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an epidemic framework of mutation, contagion, and recovery to explain how multi-agent LLM systems evolve from local deviations into collective loss of control, validating the risk of unsafe strategy propagation through implicit communication paths via a deployment audit and the RogueHandoff-20 benchmark.
